summary: Comprehensive testing of 3 bug fixes + 6 new features for Multi-Company SP ERP. Backend: 29/29 tests PASSED (100%). Frontend: All new pages and features verified via Playwright. All bugs fixed, all features working.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIX 1: Manager can create journal entries - resolve_company_id auto-scopes to assigned company
BUG FIX 2: Data isolation working - manager sees 2 entries, director sees 22+ entries
BUG FIX 3: Director executive report shows all companies with revenue/expense data
FEATURE 1: Daily Summary page shows today's activity across all companies
FEATURE 2: Director can create other directors via Users page (role selector includes Director option)
FEATURE 3: Role Management CRUD working with permissions system
FEATURE 4: Inter-Company Reconciliation with create/match/dispute workflow
FEATURE 5: Director Edit-All - can update/delete journal entries, update any task
FEATURE 6: Navigation correctly shows new items for director (Daily Summary, Reconciliation, Roles)
Role-based nav access verified - manager does NOT see director-only nav items
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed roles, reconciliation entries, and users during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bug fixes and 6 features tested and working. Daily Summary shows real-time activity data. Role Management has 3+ test roles. Reconciliation has 4 entries with different statuses. Manager is properly scoped to SP FL Shop company. Director has full access to all features.
